title: Karwa Chauth ki Veeravati Katha
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Wo chaand nahi tha... phir kya tha?

scenes.prompt: A young Indian bride in a red bridal saree with gold jewellery, holding a brass water pot, looking up at a glowing round light glimmering behind a banyan tree at dusk, a hopeful and surprised expression, village courtyard
scenes.tts: यह चाँद नहीं था! और वीरावती ने व्रत तोड़ दिया।
scenes.sub: Yeh chaand nahi tha! Aur Veeravati ne vrat tod diya.

scenes.prompt: A young bride Veeravati in a red saree with a decorated puja thali, fasting through the day in a traditional village home, seven loving elder brothers standing around her with caring faces, warm afternoon light
scenes.tts: सात भाइयों की लाडली बहन वीरावती ने पहला करवा चौथ निर्जल रखा।
scenes.sub: Saat bhaiyon ki laadli behan Veeravati ne pehla Karwa Chauth nirjal rakha.

scenes.prompt: Seven brothers lovingly worried about their tired, hungry sister, one brother holding a lit diya behind a peepal tree and another holding a sieve so it looks like a rising moon, dusk, gentle village scene
scenes.tts: भूखी बहन को देख भाइयों ने पेड़ के पीछे दीपक दिखाकर नकली चाँद बना दिया।
scenes.sub: Bhookhi behan ko dekh bhaiyon ne ped ke peeche deepak dikhakar nakli chaand bana diya.

scenes.prompt: Veeravati weeping with folded hands in a courtyard at night, and Goddess Parvati appearing in soft golden divine light, in a red saree with gold ornaments, a kind and blessing expression, lotus glow
scenes.tts: व्रत टूटते ही पति पर संकट आया। रोती वीरावती को माँ पार्वती ने दर्शन दिए।
scenes.sub: Vrat tootte hi pati par sankat aaya. Roti Veeravati ko Maa Parvati ne darshan diye.

scenes.prompt: Veeravati happily performing Karwa Chauth puja with her husband beside her, looking at the real full moon through a sieve at night, diyas glowing, joyful couple in traditional clothes, festive warm atmosphere
scenes.tts: माँ के कहे अनुसार उसने फिर श्रद्धा से व्रत किया और पति का साथ पाया।
scenes.sub: Maa ke kahe anusaar usne phir shraddha se vrat kiya aur pati ka saath paya.

scenes.tts: जय श्री श्याम! कथा अच्छी लगी हो तो लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें।
